instruction.name: xvextrins.d
instruction.description: For each 128-bit lane, copy the 64-bit element of `b` selected by `imm[0]` into the element of `a` selected by `imm[4]`; other elements remain unchanged.

experiments.name: dependent vector chain
experiments.notes: Consecutive unrolled copies form a vector-register dependency chain. Measured with unroll=100000 to amortise call overhead.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.asm: xvextrins.d $xr0, $xr8, 1; xvextrins.d $xr1, $xr9, 1; xvextrins.d $xr2, $xr10, 1; xvextrins.d $xr3, $xr11, 1; xvextrins.d $xr4, $xr12, 1; xvextrins.d $xr5, $xr13, 1; xvextrins.d $xr6, $xr14, 1; xvextrins.d $xr7, $xr15, 1
throughput.init: li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr8, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr9, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr10, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr11, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr12, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr13, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr14, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr15, $r4
throughput.command: ./bench --unroll 1000 --iters 1000 --warmup 10 --reps 7 --init 'li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr8, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr9, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr10, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr11, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr12, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr13, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr14, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr15, $r4' --asm 'xvextrins.d $xr0, $xr8, 1; xvextrins.d $xr1, $xr9, 1; xvextrins.d $xr2, $xr10, 1; xvextrins.d $xr3, $xr11, 1; xvextrins.d $xr4, $xr12, 1; xvextrins.d $xr5, $xr13, 1; xvextrins.d $xr6, $xr14, 1; xvextrins.d $xr7, $xr15, 1'

notes: LASX vector instruction. Measured on LA664 with register-only operands; latency uses a dependent chain (unroll=100000), throughput uses 8 independent lanes (unroll=1000). Latency values are reported as whole cycles; earlier two-decimal values and +/-0.1 bands were rounding artifacts of the measurement pipeline.
